title: Ku Rindza ka Lava Feriweke
intro: U le kusuhi ni ku hlangana ni moya-xiviri lowu ringiweke hi ku hambana loku dzikeke swinene, lowu mahlo ya wona a ma tiva ririmi ra mihloti kambe mbilu ya wona a yi nga si tshama yi lahlekeriwa hi ntshembo. Eka xitori xa vuxisi, ku navela, naswona eku heteleleni ku hlangana nakambe, nandza loyi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wa Allah u ve xikombiso xa ku lehisa mbilu nkarhi hinkwawo. I mani loyi a tiyiseleke malembe ya ku vava loku fihliweke, ntsena leswaku ku vona ni ntsako swi vuyeleriwile hi nkarhi wun’we?
clues: Ndzi muprofeta loyi vito ra yena ri veke xikombiso xa ku lehisa mbilu emahlweni ka ku lahlekeriwa lokukulu.
Ndzi katekisiwile hi vana vo tala va majaha, kambe un’we u tekiwile eka mina hi mavondzo ya van’wana.
Rirhandzu ra mina eka loyi a lahlekeke a ri ri rikulu swinene lerova mahlo ya mina ma hundzuke ma basa hikwalaho ka gome, hambiswiritano a ndzi si tshama ndzi vilela handle ka Allah.
Ndzi tlherisele vana va mina va majaha leswaku va ya lava loyi ndzi lahlekeriweke hi yena ni makwavo wa yena, ndzi va khutaza leswaku va nga heli ntshembo.
Loko murhwali wa mahungu lamanene a fika, ku hoxiwe hembe emahlweni ka mina, hi xitshuketa misava yi tlhele yi va erivaleni.
Ndzi tiviwa tanihi Israele, naswona eka vana va mina va khume na vambirhi ku huma tinyimba ta khume na timbirhi ta tiko lerikulu.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku hambana ni n’wana wa jaha la rhandzekaka ku ringana malembe yo tala
U karhatiwe hi vuvabyi lebyikulu bya nhlonge
Ku pfumala vana ku fikela loko u dyuharile
trial.answer: Ku hambana ni n’wana wa jaha la rhandzekaka ku ringana malembe yo tala

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku vona ku vuyelerile naswona u tlhele a hlangana ni n’wana wakwe
Ku nyikiwe ku hlula eka hosi ya tihanyi
Ku tlakusiwa ematilweni a ha hanya
U vekiwile ku va mufumi wa Egipta
Ku nyikiwa n’wana wa mufana hi vudyuhari tanihi singita
outcome.answer: Ku vona ku vuyelerile naswona u tlhele a hlangana ni n’wana wakwe

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
